i.norm: Parses a single short option "s" that is followed by extra characters ("-s-#\"J"). With stopAtNonOption enabled, the parser recognizes the leading "-s" flag and treats the remaining characters as the option's argument value, returning a non-null CommandLine.
Define a single flag option "s" (takes no argument).
First argument starts with "-s" followed by extra characters; the remaining slots are left null (unused).
